subject: Geopolitics
title: First Strike vs Second Strike
description: A 60-second lesson on First Strike vs Second Strike.

hook.text: Could you destroy all enemy missiles before they launch? If yes, you might win a nuclear war. Terrifying thought.

buildup.text: A first strike aims to destroy the enemy's weapons before they can respond. A second strike is the retaliation.

discovery.text: Submarine-launched missiles made first strikes impossible. You can't destroy what you can't find in the ocean.

twist.text: New tech like hypersonic missiles revives first-strike fears. Speed might eliminate the warning time needed to respond.

climax.text: Deterrence depends on guaranteed retaliation. Any weapon that threatens that guarantee destabilizes the entire system.

punchline.text: Safety comes from being impossible to disarm.

quiz.question: Why do submarines stabilize nuclear deterrence?
options: They can launch more missiles than silos
They guarantee a second strike because they can't be found
